AREA-NBH-HILLCREST.role: Hillcrest and Oak Park hold many of the last 3,200 customers restored on D+35; adjusters could not reach properties for two weeks.

AREA-NBH-NORTHBEACH.role: Cut off D0 to D+3 by the bridge and causeway closure; oiled shoreline from D+2.

AREA-NBH-MOLINA.role: Searches reach Greenwood and Molina on D+2 with water still two to three feet deep.

AREA-WD-3-4.role: Boil-water notice D+12 17:30 local (English), Spanish reaches KNCB 06:03 D+13; lifted D+42 11:00. 94.3% of the 1,820 Cryptosporidium/Giardia cases. District 3 = ZIPs 78405, 78416 (+78417); District 4 = 78407, 78408 (+78401).

_districts.note: PUB-203 says 'Districts 1 through 6' and NWS-P012-06 says the unaffected districts are 1, 2 and 5; five water districts are defined. Stories also say Districts 3 and 4 include 'portions of Calallen, Violet' although the notice's ZIP list does not; the ZIP list governs.
